Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver. If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact The Infrastructure Governance team within the developer enablement domain sits at the heart of Mollie's infrastructure. We own and maintain Terraform as our IaC system and play a crucial role in ensuring our infrastructure is highly reliable and compliant with industry standards like PCI-DSS, sitting directly in the critical payment path and communication layer between external works and our platform. We also manage critical components that support all of Mollie’s infrastructure. That means what we build and maintain isn't just technical infrastructure; it's the foundation that keeps payments moving safely and reliably for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe. As a Platform Engineer on this team, you'll be working on Mollie's Cloud Platform (MCP), our flavour of GCP, enabling product teams to create real value. Your work will span critical cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, and system reliability. You'll collaborate closely with system and software engineers, and interface with teams across compute, database engineering, edge, and networking. The impact is immediate and tangible: the systems you build and maintain keep Mollie's payments running. This is a role for someone who cares about quality for engineers and non-engineers alike and who brings a genuine passion for automation, distributed systems, and getting things right at scale. What you’ll ship - Design, build and maintain critical cloud infrastructure on GCP including Load Balancers, VPC, CDN, cross-region routes, and API Gateway, that keeps Mollie's payment systems running reliably. - Drive automation across the platform using Go and Python, reducing manual toil and building systems that scale without friction. - Own and evolve infrastructure as code using Terraform, managing a broad set of infrastruct

BUILD WITH US Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. YOUR IMPACT Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. WHAT YOU'LL SHIP - Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. - Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk
